title: Certificates of Deposit: The Relationship Bonus for a Renewed Term
content:
Under Piedmont Crescent Bank's Certificates of Deposit terms, a renewed term earns the Relationship Bonus or not according to the owner's Personal Checking as it stood on a single day, the renewal date. For this purpose that day is where the renewed term begins, namely the maturity date of the term just ended; when the booking itself is made is irrelevant.

## The test

The new term earns the Relationship Bonus if, on the renewal date, the owner had a checking account whose tier appears on the qualifying list for the certificate's tier. To count as held on that day, the account must have been opened no later than the renewal date and must not have closed on it or on any earlier day; a closing date, if the account has one, has to fall after the renewal date.

Two of the owner's checking accounts are looked at: the one now in active status and the one now closed. The tier, opening date and closing date of each are what decide. If either of them passes, the bonus is earned.

- An account of a listed tier that was only opened later than the renewal date brings no bonus to this term.
- An account of a listed tier that was open on the renewal date and closed some days afterwards does bring the bonus, and it makes no difference that the closing preceded the day of booking.

The Relationship Bonus marker recorded for the new term reflects the outcome.

## Cases (hypothetical: renewal date 20 November 2027, renewal booked 4 December 2027, certificate tier listing Interest, Premier and Private Client Checking)

| Owner's checking record | Relationship Bonus for the new term? |
|---|---|
| Premier Checking, active, opened 2016 | Yes |
| Premier Checking, active, opened 22 November 2027 | No; opened after the renewal date |
| Interest Checking, closed 27 November 2027, opened 2019 | Yes; still open on 20 November, and closing before the booking changes nothing |
| Private Client Checking, closed 20 November 2027, opened 2020 | No; it closed on the renewal date itself |
| Everyday Checking, active, opened 2012 | No; tier not on the list |
| No checking account at all | No |
